newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Prince George's County, Md. GOS.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Prince George's County, Md. GOS.

text.p: SEALED BIDS will be received by the County Executive of Prince George's County Executive of Prince George's County, Maryland (the County'') or by the Director of Finance, acting with the authority of the County Executive, in Suite 3200, 3rd Floor, County Administration Building, 14741 Governor Oden Bowie Drive, Upper Marlboro, Maryland 20772, for the purchase of (i) the Prince George's County, Maryland General Obligation Consolidated Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997A (the Series 1997A Bonds '') and (ii) the Prince George's County, Maryland Unlimited Tax General Obligation Stormwater Management Bonds, Series 1997B (the Series 1997B Bonds.
the Series 1997A Bonds and the Series 1997B Bonds (the Bonds'')), until: 11:00 a.m. local Baltimore, Maryland time, Tuesday, May 20,
The Bonds will mature annually, subject to prior
redemption, as described below, on March 15 in the following years and in the following aggregate amounts:
Annual Amount Maturing Annual Amount Maturing
Form of Bonds: The Bonds will be issued in ful

registered form and sold through a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to Cede & Co., the partnership nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''), and immobilized in DTC custody. The book-entry system will evidence ownership of the Bonds in the principal amount of

$5,000 and integral multiples thereof, with transfer ownership interests of each actual purchaser of a Bond effected on the records of DTC and its participants. The successful bidder, as a condition to delivery of the Bonds, shall be required to deposit the bond certificates with DTC, registered in the name of Cede & Co., DTC's partnership nominee. Optional Redemption: Outstanding Bonds maturing on or before March 15, 2007, are not subject to redemption prior to their maturity. Bonds maturing on or after March 15, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to maturity in whole or in part on March 15, 2007 or at any time thereafter at the option of the County and in order of maturity directed by the County, on at least thirty (30) days' notice, at the following redemption prices, expressed as percentages of the principal amount of the Bonds or portions thereof to be redeemed, plus accrued interest thereon to the date fixed for redemption:
Redemption Period (both dates inclusive) Redemption Price

Authority to Issue: The Bonds are to be issued under the authority of Article 25A of the Annotated Code of Maryland (1996 Replacement Volume), the Charter of Prince George's County, Maryland, County Council Bills CB-27-1996, CB-28- 1996 and CB-97-1996, certain bond enabling acts cited therein and orders of the County Executive. Purpose: The Series 1997A Bonds are being issued to provide funds for the purpose of the construction,
acquisition, improvement or extension of certain projects including school buildings, roads and bridges, libraries, community college facilities, mass transit facilities,

health and correctional facilities and County buildings and facilities. The Series 1997B Bonds are being issued to provide funds for financing in whole or in part the costs of planning, construction, reconstruction, acquisition, establishment, extension, enlargement, demolition or purchase of certain capital projects constituting facilities for the control and disposition of storm and surface waters. Price and Interest Rate Bid: Each bidder shall submit one bid on an

st specify the amount of the bid for the Bonds, which must be at least par, and must specify the rate or rates of interest to be paid thereon, in multiples of one-eighth (1/8) or one- twentieth (1/20) of one percent (1%). The difference between the minimum and maximum interest rates specified may not exceed three percent (3%). A zero rate cannot be named for any maturity. Term Bonds Designation at the Bidder's Option: Bidders may designate in their bids for each Series of Bonds two or more consecutive annual principal payments as a term bond which

matures on the maturity date of the last annual prin payment of the sequence. Any term bond so designated shall be subject to mandatory sinking fund redemption in each year on the principal payment dates of the sequence. Acquisition of Bond Insurance at the Bidder's Option: The County has requested certain municipal bond insurers to qualify the Bonds for municipal bond insurance. If the Bonds qualify for issuance of any policy of bond insurance, any purchase of such insurance or commitment therefor shall be at the sole option and expense of the bidder. Good Faith Deposit: Bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $899,000 in the form of (i) a certified, cashier's or treasurer's check, drawn on a responsible financial institution payable to the order of Prince George's County, Maryland, or (ii) a financial surety bond naming the County as beneficiary. If a financial surety bond is provided, it must be from an insurance company whose claims paying ability is rated AAA by Standard & Poor's, or Aaa by Moody's Investors Service, and which is licensed to issue such a bond in the State of Maryland. Award of Bonds: The County will not consider and will reject any bid for the purchase of less than all of the Bonds. No bid at less than par plus accrued interest will be considered. The right is reserved to reject any and all bids. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase the Bonds at the lowest true interest cost (TIC) to the County. The TIC shall be determined by doubling the semiannual interest rate (compounded semiannually) necessary to discount the debt service payments form the payment dates to the date of the Bonds and to the price bid, excluding interest accrued to the date of delivery. The Bonds will be delivered on or about June 17, 1997. The approving opinion of Shapiro and Olander, Baltimore, Maryland, and Smallwood & Wells P.A., Largo, Maryland, Co- Bond Counsel, will be delivered upon request, without charge, to the successful bidder for the Bonds. Each bid must be on a form to be furnished by the undersigned, copies of which together with the Preliminary Official Statement and the official Notice of Sale and Bid for Bonds may be obtained from the Director of Finance of Prince George's County, Maryland, County Administration Building, Room 3200, 14741 Governor Oden Bowie Drive, Upper Marlboro, Maryland 20772, (301) 952-5025, or from Public Advisory Consultants, Inc., 117 Water Street, Suite 800, Baltimore, Maryland 21202, (410) 539-2418, the County's Financial.
